meaning: The only available audit record combines multiple experiments, so no parent value is experiment-specific.
manual_action: Disaggregate the source record by experiment before accepting any atomic value.

meaning: A coarse audit parent is reported, but this target method/validation leaf has not been separately verified.
manual_action: Disaggregate the parent evidence and enter the atomic value.

meaning: A coarse parent is explicitly absent; applicability/absence of this individual leaf still needs confirmation.
manual_action: Verify which leaves are absent versus not applicable.

meaning: The coarse parent is reported with a caveat.
manual_action: Recover the leaf and preserve/resolve the caveat.

meaning: The parent is represented with a Toolkit distribution rather than one source-exact value.
manual_action: Verify the target-leaf translation.

meaning: Tracked sources conflict at the parent level.
manual_action: Resolve the source conflict before encoding the leaf.

meaning: The parent contains a derived value.
manual_action: Verify the derivation at this leaf's unit/frame.

meaning: The parent comes from a cited predecessor protocol.
manual_action: Verify lineage applicability to this experiment.

meaning: Only an automated/weak parent candidate exists.
manual_action: Inspect the primary source and confirm the atomic value.

meaning: Critical review found the parent unreported.
manual_action: Inspect lineage or choose/document an explicit default.

meaning: The coarse parent is not applicable.
manual_action: Confirm applicability for this individual leaf.

meaning: An audit record exists but usable evidence for the parent is absent or not yet extracted.
manual_action: Acquire/open and review the source.

meaning: No exact-DOI audit record joins to this network publication.
manual_action: Create a publication audit.

meaning: The target method/validation leaf has no parent in the current 25-field extraction schema.
manual_action: Review the new atomic leaf directly from source.

meaning: This leaf maps to multiple coarse parents with different states.
manual_action: Resolve each parent before atomic entry.

meaning: Study instances under the same publication differ.
manual_action: Use the registered study-instance matrix rather than the aggregate node row.

meaning: The target concept has a conservative direct binding to one or more exact current serialized design paths.
manual_action: Review the exact path values and publication evidence.

meaning: A current typed input exists but units or representation must be transformed.
manual_action: Verify the transformation explicitly.

meaning: The target concept spans multiple exact current typed inputs.
manual_action: Review every mapped path together.

meaning: The current typed field represents only part of the target concept or an approximation.
manual_action: Treat the uncovered portion as an implementation gap.

meaning: The value can be stored in an arbitrary object but lacks its own typed serializer field.
manual_action: Promote it to a typed input when method-defining.

meaning: The target value is computed from current inputs rather than entered directly.
manual_action: Keep source target and computed value in validation evidence.

meaning: No conservative binding to the current StimulusDesign serializer was established.
manual_action: Implement a typed input or trace a separate versioned runtime/analysis contract.

meaning: Earlier inventory suggested a GUI route; this is unverified until an exact serialized-path binding test exists.
manual_action: Confirm against the current-input crosswalk and a control-to-serializer test.

meaning: Earlier inventory suggested a backend route; this is unverified until an exact parser/serializer binding exists.
manual_action: Confirm against the current-input crosswalk.

meaning: Likely belongs to runtime configuration rather than the current study-design serializer.
manual_action: Trace the exact runtime input contract.

meaning: Likely belongs to analysis configuration rather than the current study-design serializer.
manual_action: Trace the exact analysis input contract.

meaning: Likely belongs to calibration configuration rather than the current study-design serializer.
manual_action: Trace the exact calibration input contract.

meaning: Likely retained only in an untyped/free-form object.
manual_action: Promote to a typed input if it is method-defining.

meaning: Likely computed/materialized rather than accepted as a primary design input.
manual_action: Keep as validation evidence unless a real input binding is traced.

meaning: Toolkit behavior appears fixed rather than profile-configurable.
manual_action: Expose a typed policy only when publications differ.

meaning: Toolkit may only approximate or substitute the source method.
manual_action: Document the equivalence boundary and caveat.

meaning: No candidate typed structure was found in the earlier inventory.
manual_action: Confirm against the exact crosswalk, then implement and validate.

meaning: No route has been assessed.
manual_action: Trace code, serializer, and production consumers.
